interpretation: Selected reference inputs and four evidence follow-ups, not whole-corpus experimental signoff.
Only AAC(3)-IIIb/Q51405 adds a gene-reference link; nine memberships are not nine AST results.
The unreviewed reference has no explicit CARD xref or established experimental allele identity.
Generic type-IV references are not exact IVa; Kpn complexes, cipA and Vgb retain their qualified context.
All access holds and primary-review limitations remain in their pinned dossiers.
No-candidate status means no reference in these selected index inputs, not biological absence.
PHI, curator, HIVDB and no-claim records are retained, not reassessed by this index update.
